lighting_shading.note: Soft, even lighting with gentle gradients and no harsh shadows.

value_contrast.note: Light subject stands out clearly against the darker background.

color_palette.note: Warm cream column contrasts with the magenta background.

composition_hierarchy.note: Strong vertical composition with a single, clear focal point.

shape_proportions.note: Simplified, chunky forms with a highly readable silhouette.

viewpoint_depth.note: Slight three-quarter view gives depth without strong perspective.

edges_linework.note: Clean, soft edges defined by shading rather than line art.

surface_finish.note: Smooth, matte finish typical of stylized 3D mobile game assets.

rhythm_staging.note: Static, near-symmetric pose with a calm, stable energy.
